The Obelo web UI was not built into this binary.

The API is unaffected and is serving normally under /api/v1 — only the browser interface is missing. Apple TV, iPhone, and iPad clients do not use this page and will work as usual.

Build the frontend bundle, then rebuild the server:

make build

make build runs the Vite build first and embeds its output here. Building with plain go build skips that step, which is what produced this page.
